rows.displayName: Numerical semiampleness of nef adjoint classes on compact Kähler manifolds

claim.ja: smooth compact Kähler上の有理SNC klt対で、K+Bがpseudo-effective、MとK+B+Mがnefなら、同じ実Bott–Chern類を持つsemiample有理lineが存在する。
claim.en: For a smooth compact Kähler rational SNC klt pair, with K+B pseudo-effective and M and K+B+M nef, a semiample rational line represents the same real Bott–Chern class.

role.ja: 代数次元0での消滅、nef lineの降下、射影底上のpositive partを合流させる。
role.en: Combines vanishing in algebraic dimension zero, descent of nef lines and positive parts on a projective base.

rows.displayName: Numerical Semiampleness of Nef Adjoint Divisors

claim.ja: 標数0の射影klt有理対、K+B pseudo-effective、X上のM nef、K+B+M nefから、同じX上のsemiample有理因子との数値同値を得る。
claim.en: For a projective klt rational pair in characteristic zero with K+B pseudo-effective, M nef on X and K+B+M nef, obtains numerical equivalence to a semiample rational divisor on X.

role.ja: full nef dimensionからbig性への帰着と、nef reductionによるpositive partの帰納法。
role.en: Bigness from full nef dimension and induction for positive parts via nef reduction.

rows.displayName: Minimal models and Mori fibre spaces for generalized log canonical Q-pairs

claim.ja: 固定nef有理b-divisorを持つ射影generalized lc対で、adjointがpseudo-effectiveなら極小モデル、それ以外はMori fibre spaceが存在する。
claim.en: For a projective generalized lc rational pair with fixed nef rational b-data, gives a minimal model for a pseudo-effective adjoint and a Mori fibre space otherwise.

role.ja: 局所位相とsmooth relative weak Zariski decompositionから、NQC generalized MMPへ移す。
role.en: Transfers a local phase argument and smooth relative weak Zariski decompositions to the NQC generalized MMP.

rows.displayName: Minimal models in numerical dimension one

claim.ja: 複素射影smooth X、dim X≥3、KX pseudo-effective、切断増大による数値次元1ならQ-factorial terminal極小モデル。別入力で同じ終点がgoodとなる。
claim.en: A smooth complex projective X of dimension at least three with pseudo-effective KX and section-growth numerical dimension one has a Q-factorial terminal minimal model; a separate input makes the same endpoint good.

role.ja: 余次元2で固定したモデルと二つの曲面でnef性を示す独立の経路。
role.en: A separate route to nefness using a model fixed in codimension two and two surfaces.
